content:
Tickets are on sale for one of Laredo's biggest high school football rivalries: the 59th annual Martin-Nixon game, set for 7 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 7, at Shirley Field, according to KGNS.

Reserved seats are $12, general admission is $10 and student tickets are $2, with veterans admitted free, KGNS reported. Tickets are available through the GoFan app or at laredoisd.org, and ticket information is available from the Laredo Independent School District Athletic Office.

The district's clear bag policy will be enforced at the game, according to KGNS.

Sources:

  • KGNS, "Tickets on sale for 59th annual Martin-Nixon football game," Oct. 27, 2026
